description: This file contains tests for the 'audit-seams' module, verifying detection and classification of various 'seam' boundaries within specific source files related to cron jobs, subagents, and their respective lifecycle events. It uses the Vitest testing framework to evaluate seam detection functions and their accuracy against sample source code snippets.

methods.name: runCronIsolatedAgentTurn
methods.description: Simulates the execution of a cron agent turn, registers context, runs agent with fallback, delivers outbound payloads, and builds a session context.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts cron scheduler operations, ensuring data is loaded, recomputing next runs, persisting state, arming timers, running missed jobs, and computing next run time.

methods.name: spawnSubagentDirect
methods.description: Handles subagent spawn process, calling gateway, registering subagent, deleting session, and emitting lifecycle event.

methods.name: completeRun
methods.description: Completes a subagent run by resolving context, capturing completion reply, emitting end hook, persisting state, and running announce flow.

methods.name: startAcpSpawnParentStreamRelay
methods.description: Sets up parent stream relay for ACP spawn, listening for agent output, requesting heartbeat, and enqueuing system event.
